title: Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals for Non-Injective Neural Mappings
abstract: arXiv:2609.37272v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Non-injective mappings in neural networks map distinct inputs to the same representation, thereby implicitly inducing equivalence relations in the input space. However, the input differences eliminated by these mappings may still be required by downstream tasks, creating a mismatch between operator-induced indistinguishability and task-required distinctions. For non-injective linear operators realized in the current forward pass, their null spaces exactly characterize these invisible input variations. We propose Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals (NSR), a general residual framework for non-injective linear mappings. NSR combines null-space component extraction from pre-mapping representations, member-level encoding and gating, and application-specific integration to exploit potentially task-relevant information under downstream supervision while preserving the original aggregation or merging rules. translated_title: 面向非单射神经映射的任务相关零空间残差
translated_abstract: 神经网络中的非单射映射会将不同的输入映射到相同的表示，从而在输入空间中隐式地引入等价关系。然而，这些映射所消除的输入差异可能仍然是下游任务所需要的，这就造成了算子导致的不可区分性与任务所需区分性之间的不匹配。对于在当前前向传播中实现的非单射线性算子，其零空间恰好刻画了这些不可见的输入变化。我们提出了任务相关零空间残差（NSR），这是一个面向非单射线性映射的通用残差框架。NSR 结合了从映射前表示中提取零空间分量、成员级编码与门控机制，以及面向具体应用的集成方式，从而在下游监督下挖掘潜在的任务相关信息，同时保留原有的聚合或合并规则。我们在两种结构不同的（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出任务相关零空间残差（NSR）框架，通过提取非单射线性映射零空间中的分量并在下游监督下加以利用，在不破坏原有聚合或合并规则的前提下，弥补映射造成的输入不可区分性与下游任务所需区分性之间的差距。
en_tdlr: We propose Task-Relevant Null-Space Residuals (NSR), a general residual framework that extracts null-space components of non-injective linear mappings and exploits potentially task-relevant input variations under downstream supervision, while preserving the original aggregation or merging rules.
